# Atlanta Hard Money Lenders

> Independent comparison of Metro Atlanta / Georgia hard money and private money lenders for fix-and-flip, bridge, BRRRR, and new construction. Terms and contacts are taken from each lender’s public website and dated. Not lending advice; not affiliated with listed lenders.

Website: https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-hard-money/
Last verified: 2026-11-09
Listing count: 11 lenders

## How to cite
Cite the lender name and link to the lender’s own website or source URL. Treat LTV, rates, and terms as snapshots as of the verification date; confirm in writing with the lender.

## Key pages
- [Directory](https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-hard-money/): searchable table of lenders with published terms, contacts, and verification dates.
- [Machine-readable listings](https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-hard-money/lenders.json)
- [Sitemap](https://wu12bri.github.io/atlanta-hard-money/sitemap.xml)

## What this site is not
Not a broker, not a rate guarantee, not credit or legal advice. Unpublished fields stay “Not published”. Offline lender sites are flagged rather than guessed.
